objective: Dynamically validate whether the default Zipkin HTTP collector can be driven to OOM or sustained unavailability by anonymous POST /api/v2/spans requests before default request/storage bounds reject the input.

deployment_plan.application_heap: image default for openzipkin/zipkin-slim, documented as 32m

probe_plan.body_sizes: bounded generated valid v2 span JSON batches
stop_conditions: OutOfMemoryError or GC overhead in logs

evidence_plan: docker pull and image inspect output
docker run command and startup logs
per-request HTTP status, latency, body sizes, health status, RSS and docker state

judgment_rules.confirmed: Only OOM, GC death, restart, thread/connection exhaustion, or sustained HTTP unavailability under default deployment.
judgment_rules.not_confirmed: 413/default rejection, no meaningful growth, or growth without failure before safety caps.
